expectation: CDX2 should be a nuclear stain, strong in the nuclei of intestinal epithelial cells (enterocytes and crypt cells). It should be common along the mucosal lining of villi and crypts. It should be absent from stroma, muscle and lymphoid cells.
observed: A: yellow haze covers most of the tissue, including the right-hand piece, which shows tile stripes and fold lines. B and C: diffuse haze with a few bright blobs, and no discrete nuclei. D: yellow clumps sit between the nuclei, not on them. E1/E3: grainy speckle with no nuclear pattern. Ecadherin (E2) shows no cellular structure, so it cannot confirm anything.
why: The signal is diffuse haze that follows tissue and has tile or fold artefacts, with a few bright blobs and no discrete nuclear-localised epithelial population.
